features: HIGH CAPACITY STORAGE: This 256GB microSDXC card offers ample space to store photos, videos, apps, and more on your devices.
FAST READ SPEEDS: With up to 140MB/s read speed, transferring and accessing your files is quick and efficient.
CLASS 10 / UHS-I RATED: Rated Class 10 and UHS Speed Class 1 (U1), ensuring smooth and reliable performance for everyday use.

description: The GNS World 128GB microSD card is a high-performance storage solution designed to meet the demands of modern digital devices. With an impressive read speed of up to 140 MB/s, this card ensures swift data transfers, making it ideal for storing photos, videos, music, and more. Rated as a Class 10, UHS-I (U1) card, it delivers consistent and reliable performance for everyday tasks such as recording Full HD videos and capturing high-resolution images. The microSDXC format makes it compatible with a wide range of devices, including smartphones, tablets, action cameras, dash cams, and more. Its compact form factor allows it to fit seamlessly into any microSD-compatible slot without adding any bulk. Whether you are a photography enthusiast looking to expand your camera's storage or a gamer seeking additional space for your favourite titles, this GNS World microSD card is a dependable choice. Please verify device compatibility before purchasing to ensure the best experience.
